subject: Seat flexibility & add-on migration plan for ClearVista
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearvista.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Packaging options for ClearVista — quick clarification

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call earlier. Thanks for walking through ClearVista's migration timeline. I put together three concise packaging options so procurement has a clear starting point. Quick questions before I pull together a formal quote: 

- Expected number of "active" seats in month 1 vs. steady state (projected).
- Whether ClearVista needs private VPC (on-prem-like) from day one or can start on Hosted and migrate to Private later.
- Any required SLAs (SLA minutiae) beyond 99.9%? You mentioned 24/7 was nice-to-have.

High-level option summaries (I'll attach a matrix):
1) Hosted Core — pay-as-you-go with seat-based seat-pool credits; low commitment, standard SLAs.
2) Dedicated + Add-ons — dedicated GPU pool, optional Private VPC + SSO add-on, seat-pool credits for flexible allocation.
3) Enterprise Private — full Private deployment, 24/7 support, on-call rotations, migration assistance and custom billing cadence.

I can include two negotiation paths: a 12-month contract with a flexible seat-pool add-on, or a multi-year commit with deeper discounts and migration credits. Sending a pricing matrix + SOW draft in the next email. Would you be available for a procurement call next week (Tue/Wed preferred)?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0194

Attachments: (placeholder) redwood-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx (will follow)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearvista.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearvista.io
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 14:03:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for ClearVista — quick clarification

Thanks Jonas — high-level answers below: 

- Active seats initial: ~45 (pilot team), projected steady state: ~180 within 9 months.
- We prefer Private deployment eventually; pilot can start on Hosted if the migration path is clearly defined and supported.
- SLA: 99.95% is preferred for production workloads; 24/7 support is a firm ask for Enterprise.
- Budget: target Opex for year 1 is ~$200k (flexible if value demonstrated). Procurement will want a PO + net-30 invoicing cadence.

Two important constraints from our side (see attached RFP):
1) Seat pooling: we need the ability to move seats between teams without per-seat re-procurement.
2) License mobility: add/remove seats monthly; overage billing must be transparent.

Please include per-seat pricing, seat-pool mechanism, migration assistance pricing, and an example invoice cadence in the matrix.

We can do Wed, Jan 14 at 10:00 PT for a procurement sync if that works.

Elena Ruiz
Head of AI Platform — ClearVista
elena@clearvista.io

Attachments: clearvista-rfp-2026.pdf (procurement file)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearvista.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging options for ClearVista — quick clarification

Elena — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we need. Attached is the redwood-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx and a first-pass SOW draft (PDF). Summary pulled from the matrix below so procurement can scan quickly: 

Option A — Hosted Core (low friction)
- Seat-pool credits: $450 / seat-month baseline
- Migration assistance (one-time): $18k (30 hours of engineering + runbook)
- SLA: 99.9% (upgrade possible with add-on)

Option B — Dedicated + Private Add-on (recommended pilot path)
- Dedicated GPU pool + Private VPC option: base commit $95k/year (minimum 200 GPU hours/month equivalent)
- Seat add-on (pool credits): $380 / seat-month
- Migration assistance: $12k (accelerated onboarding)
- Optional 24/7 support add-on: $6k/month

Option C — Enterprise Private (production, 24/7, long-term)
- 3-year typical structure: blended effective seat price ~$290 / seat-month (after multi-year discount)
- Migration, SSO, on-prem connectors included in migration credit
- Custom billing cadence; can support quarterly invoicing

Negotiation levers I will propose: 
- 1-year term: 10–12% list discount, seat-flex add-on allowed, invoice net-30.
- 3-year term: 15–22% list discount depending on committed GPU hours and MRR guarantee.

DocuSign link to SOW draft: https://www.docusign.com/link/to/SOW-CLV-0431
Please review the attached matrix and SOW — I flagged the seat-pool and overage sections.

Would you like me to prepare a clean quote with the 12-month flexible-seat option at a 12% discount for your procurement call on Wed?

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachments: redwood-pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearvista.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Packaging options for ClearVista — quick clarification

Elena / Jonas — looping in guidance from the commercial side so we have clear guardrails for the procurement conversation. High-level negotiation guidance (authorized):

- 12-month term: up to 12% discount off list for seat-flexibility (approved). Include a seat-pool mechanism with monthly true-up; overage billing at agreed seat-month rate.
- 24-month term: 15% discount with $60k minimum annual commit.
- 36-month term: up to 20% discount with $150k annual minimum commit and standard migration credits (we waive up to $25k in onboarding fees).

Concessions:
- We can offer one month of seat credits free (pilot credit) if they sign within 30 days of the quote.
- 24/7 support is an add-on priced at $6k/month. If they lock a 3-year term, we can include first 3 months of support at no charge.

Hard limits: any discount above 18% requires VP approval and must be accompanied by a signed MSA that includes a minimum quarterly billing cadence.

Jonas — please reflect the 12% option in the quote for Wed and include a clear statement of the seat pooling mechanism and monthly true-up. Elena — happy to join the call if you want direct commercial coverage.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial — Redwood Inference

Elena — quick finance note to avoid holdups on procurement: 

- We can do net-30 invoicing for the 12-month term. For revenue recognition purposes, we need a PO that matches the total invoice amount and the billing cadence.
- Preferred billing cadence: quarterly invoices align best with our ops for Dedicated/Private deployments. We can support monthly billing on Hosted Core.
- If ClearVista requires specific wording for tax or software resale clauses, please share your PO template; we'll confirm any required redlines.

Attached: billing-terms-excerpt.pdf (shows standard invoice language + required PO fields).

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks all — this is helpful. Procurement reviewed Marissa's guidance and Ben's billing note. ClearVista is prepared to move forward with the following ask for the procurement call: 

- Please provide a formal quote reflecting: 12% discount on Option B (Dedicated + Private Add-on) for a 12-month term with seat-pool flexibility.
- Include monthly seat true-up language, example invoice for first quarter, and migration assistance line item at the $12k figure discussed.
- We will send our PO template prior to the call (attached).

Let's do the procurement sync on Wed, Jan 21 at 10:00 PT (moved due to internal calendars). Can Jonas send the updated quote and an updated SOW/DocuSign link by EOD Mon, Jan 19 so procurement has time to align?

Elena Ruiz
Head of AI Platform — ClearVista
